environment.description: Same Go Gin binary packaged as a container image and deployed as an AWS Lambda function with a Function URL. The Function URL is configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The Lambda resource policy does not include a principal wildcard (*) — it specifies only the internal service role arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/InternalApiCallerRole as the allowed invoker. The function URL endpoint returns HTTP 403 {"Message":"Forbidden"} for any request that does not carry a valid SigV4 signature from the authorized principal. CloudWatch logs confirm no invocations from unauthorized callers. Note: the Go binary still listens on :8080 inside the Lambda runtime adapter (aws-lambda-web-adapter), but the Lambda service mesh terminates TLS and enforces IAM auth before traffic reaches the adapter.

config.runtime: AWS Lambda (container image, custom runtime via aws-lambda-web-adapter)
config.network: Lambda VPC-attached, no public IP, egress-only NAT
